free_tier.stated: No free tier. NAT-1 is Rp 8,500.00 a month: 128 MB RAM, 2 GB disk, 125 GB bandwidth, 1 shared NAT IPv4, 19 range ports plus 1 SSH port, a /80 IPv6 block, OpenVZ, multi-location. The store page marks it '10 Available'.

retention.stated: the payment page states the vendor waits 2 days for payment: 'Kami menunggu pembayaran dari anda selama 2 (DUA) Hari.' No deletion window after that is stated on the pages read

egress.terms: 125 GB of bandwidth a month on NAT-1; no overage price and no shaping rule is published on the page read

interface_detail: Root on an OpenVZ container over SSH, reached through the shared IPv4 on one of the assigned ports or directly over the /80 IPv6 block. 'Multi Location' is printed but the locations are not enumerated on the store page.
tooling: any SSH client. The panel is WHMCS; no API documented and no VPS control panel is named on the store page.
chaining: USD 0.470 a month, the cheapest monthly figure and cheaper than any annual prepay found, for 128 MB and 2 GB with a /80 IPv6 block and 19 NAT ports; the shape is small enough that it is a DNS resolver, a monitoring probe or a tunnel endpoint rather than a general host.

limits.value: 1 shared NAT IPv4 with '19 range Port + 1 SSH Port'; the ports are a range, not individually chosen
2 GB of disk, the smallest disk; OpenVZ rather than KVM, so no custom kernel

binding_note: 128 MB of RAM and 2 GB of disk bind before the traffic does: the box will run a resolver or a tunnel but not a package manager's worth of updates on top of a web stack.

identity_cost.detail: no card at registration, and no separate registration form: the vendor's register.php states 'To create an account, please place an order with us', so the account is created at checkout. Payment is by bank transfer or PayPal - the payment page says 'Pembayaran dapat di lakukan melalui Bank dan Rekening Paypal di bawah ini' and the account details are shown only after login, at ca.idreg.net/rekening.php, which states 'Anda harus login untuk mengakses halaman ini'. No card hold or authorisation amount is stated anywhere read, and no card is needed because neither rail is a card rail.

reliability_note: No reliability event observed. No SLA and no status page were found on the pages read.
confidence_note: the Rp 8,500 monthly price, the shape, the 19+1 port split, the /80 IPv6 block and the '10 Available' stock line are quoted from the vendor's own store page read today. The registration-at-checkout behaviour and the payment rails are quoted from the vendor's own register.php and payment pages. UDP on the forwarded ports is not stated. The locations are not enumerated.

the stock counters, read from the page markup: 'NAT-1 | 10 Available', 'NAT-2 | 10 Available', 'NAT-3 | 3 Available', 'NAT-4 | 5 Available'; the same page also lists NAT-2 at Rp 14.000,00 for 256 MB / 4 GB / 250 GB and NAT-3 at Rp 20.000,00 for 512 MB / 8 GB / 500 GB
quoted: 'To create an account, please place an order with us' - there is no standalone registration form; the page carries only a login form
quoted: 'Pembayaran dapat di lakukan melalui Bank dan Rekening Paypal di bawah ini' and 'Kami menunggu pembayaran dari anda selama 2 (DUA) Hari.'
quoted: 'Anda harus login untuk mengakses halaman ini. Rincian ini berbeda dengan login username dan password control panel website anda.' - the bank details are behind the account

notes: This is the cheapest monthly figure found at USD 0.470, and unlike most of the others it needs no annual prepay. The stock counter is explicit and per-plan, which is the strongest stock signal. Two things were not established. First, the locations: 'Multi Location' is printed but no list of countries appears on the store page, so a buyer cannot tell which country the box lands in before ordering. Second, whether the 19 ports are assigned or chosen - the page says 'range', which implies a contiguous assigned block, but no mapping procedure is documented. The vendor is Indonesian (idreg.net, prices in rupiah, Indonesian-language storefront with an English toggle). Payment being bank transfer and PayPal means the first payment may need manual confirmation rather than instant provisioning. The storefront's own 'Pesan Sekarang' link points at cart.php?a=add&pid=297, but that URL redirects to an unrelated cPanel hosting page ('Web Hosting Singapore', final_url /store/cpanel-host-sg) when fetched, so the working entry point recorded here is the product page /store/vps-nat/nat-1, which renders the NAT-1 card and its stock counter. The pid link may still work in a browser with a session; it does not work for a cold reader, which is what a human following this record would be.

extras.price_arithmetic: Rp 8,500.00 a month, billed monthly; 8500 / 18089.973852 = USD 0.4699, rounded to USD 0.470. Rate: 1 USD = IDR 18089.973852 (open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, time_last_update_utc Sat, 24 Oct 2026 00:02:31 +0000). A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so 24/7 and 10 h/day are the same.
